notes: jam-actions-v1, 9 families after chunks 16-26 (349 records, 232/117; 162 acoustic with two draws per class per song, onsets on both sides of zero, signed pitch_fail, two-sided 40 ms gate). Inherits the acoustic-sft shape that trained cleanly on an L40S: 1x8 batch, bf16 LoRA r=16, cosine, seed 13. Two deliberate differences. epochs 3 not 5, because v0 saturated at epoch 3 and epochs 4-5 bought nothing -- measured, see experiments/acoustic-sft/RESULTS.md. And max_seq_len stays 16384 pending the dry-run: v1 traces are shorter than v0's but carry the same 54-tool catalog, which alone is ~13k tokens, so the catalog dominates either way. Confirm with --dry-run on the pod before training; the trainer refuses to truncate.
